weekNumRule.title: Week number rule
weekNumRule.hint: Calendar week: the week containing Jan 1 is week 1. ISO 8601: the week starts on Monday and the week containing the first Thursday is week 1; it only takes effect when “Week starts on” is set to Monday. Weekly notes with document attributes are unaffected by switching rules; if historical weekly notes have no attributes yet, run “Backfill Now” before changing this setting.

backfillAttrs.title: Backfill periodic note attributes
backfillAttrs.hint: Periodic notes created after v0.5.0 already have document attributes automatically. Only notes created before v0.5.0 need backfilling. This scans the weekly/monthly/yearly notes in the current notebook and adds missing attributes, so the calendar can still find them even if you change their storage paths later.
backfillAttrs.nothingToBackfill: All periodic notes already have attributes. Nothing to backfill.
backfillAttrs.error: Failed to backfill attributes. Check console for details.
backfillAttrs.noNotebook: No notebook selected. Please select a notebook first.
backfillAttrs.notSupported: Backfill is not supported by the current notebook instance.

dayRolloverHour.title: Hari baru dimulai pada
dayRolloverHour.hint: Sebelum waktu ini, "hari ini" masih diperlakukan sebagai hari sebelumnya. Misalnya, dengan 02:30, mengklik Hari Ini sebelum pukul 2:30 akan membuka/membuat catatan hari sebelumnya. Jam 0–23, menit 0–59.

confirmCreateDailyNote.title: Konfirmasi sebelum membuat catatan harian
confirmCreateDailyNote.hint: Jika diaktifkan, mengklik tanggal tanpa catatan harian menampilkan dialog konfirmasi. Matikan untuk membuat langsung.
